post.description: Enqueues the exact immutable saved version with real time_range and timezone under the existing query budgets. An identical actor/project/version/key/payload reuses its query job for seven days. Changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; expired or deleted jobs within the retry window return QUERY_REQUEST_EXPIRED. Disabled execution returns 503. Resource environment cannot be overridden.

application_state.description: 当前接收器通过共享数据库读取配置，凭据缓存最长 2 秒。变更提交后，首次读取观察到该版本才开始计时；等待缓存失效窗口后 applied。它表示旧缓存已过期，不代表每个节点逐一确认；依赖不可用时接收器关闭接入。

schema.description: 受限的扁平属性定义：最多50个字段，仅字符串、有限安全数值、布尔值和最多20项的同类型标量数组。必须显式禁止额外属性；不支持远程引用、嵌套对象、正则和组合规则。详细限制与发布完整性由事件校验服务验证。

DraftInput.description: schema 必须提交并整体替换；省略可选元数据保留旧值，显式空对象或数组表示清空。空字符串与省略不同。发布时必须补全触发条件、来源类型、事实类型并通过样例验证。

expected_active_revision.description: 比较实际已激活版本，不是最近构建版本。通过激活查询读取；尚未激活时为 0。

state.description: published 表示不可变定义已构建并持久保存；是否可以接收事件必须单独检查 ingestion_ready。

active_release_revision.description: 当前已激活版本；尚未激活时为 0。

server_secret_once.description: 仅服务端来源创建或轮换时返回一次；不允许进入列表或日志

schema.description: 仅保留客户端校验所需关键词，移除示例、描述、默认值及内部元数据。

events.description: 只包含当前来源类型可上报的事件；允许为空。

approximate_aggregations.description: Only unique and p95 accept explicit approximate accuracy; all aggregations default to exact.

AnalysisCatalogField.description: Property operators use the existing engine: is_present tests key existence, including explicit null; is_missing tests absent keys within the referenced event/version. Typed comparisons exclude null and absent values. Nullable schema unions and unsupported nested/object fields are omitted.

AnalysisCatalogEvent.description: Read-only immutable version metadata published in this environment. active means included in the current default active release; ingestion_ready additionally requires that active release to have a current verified readiness lease. Neither flag proves source eligibility or query capacity. fields includes only supported top-level typed properties.

QueryValidation.description: Read-only dry validation; no query job, scan or result is created. execution_available reports runtime configuration, not proven capacity or execution success. Unfixed event_keys/all_events remain unfixed; only manifest event_versions are immutable dependencies. Execution reauthorizes and revalidates.

SavedAnalysisDefinition.description: At most 131072 UTF-8 encoded JSON bytes. Server normalization trims title and defaults description. Visualization compatibility is validated without executing the query.

SavedAnalysisValidation.description: Read-only semantic validation. No query execution, mutation or audit write occurs. The validation hash binds the resource scope, draft/publication counters, normalized definition, dependencies and bounded diff; publication reauthorizes and recomputes it transactionally.

SavedAnalysisExecute.description: Binds caller-supplied time_range and timezone to the immutable published configuration and its stored environment.
